body_markdown:
**If you’re a Horizons grantee, here’s what you need to know:**


Horizons Foundation, the world’s first community foundation of, by, and for LGBTQ people, has partnered with Chariot to send grant payments electronically. Since 1980, Horizons has invested in LGBTQ nonprofits, often prioritizing grassroots organizations serving the community’s most under-resourced populations. Now, those grants can reach you faster and more securely than a paper check.


“Through Chariot, Horizons is excited to offer our grantee partners and donors a faster, simpler way to get critical funding out the door and into the accounts of the nonprofits that our community members rely on,” said Horizons Foundation CFO Amie Haiz.


**What’s changing**


Horizons now sends grants through Chariot Disbursements. If your organization has a Chariot Deposit Account*, grants arrive instantly, with grant details in clear, standardized fields that make reconciliation easier for your finance team.


Horizons joins a growing group of grantmakers paying nonprofits through Chariot, including the Saint Paul & Minnesota Foundation, Charityvest, Daffy, and TIFIN Give.


**What you need to do**


- **Already have a Chariot Deposit Account?** Nothing. Grants from Horizons will land in your account automatically.
- **Don’t have one yet?** When Horizons sends you a grant, you’ll get an email letting you know funds are on the way, with a link to claim your free Chariot Deposit Account and receive the grant electronically.
- **Prefer a check?** If you don’t claim your account within 5 business days, your grant will be sent via mail with a grant letter and full grant details.


**Frequently asked questions**


**Does it cost anything?**


No. Your Chariot Deposit Account is free, and you can transfer funds to your external financial account at no cost, anytime.


**When did this start?**


Horizons began sending grants through Chariot in November 2026.


**Can we receive grants from other grantmakers in the same account?**


Yes. Your account can receive grants from grantmaker or DAF sponsors on the Chariot network, so you only need to set it up once.


**How will we know a grant has arrived?**


Everyone on your account gets an email when funds land. You can change notification preferences in your dashboard settings.


**Learn more**


Read Horizons Foundation’s[Chariot Disbursements FAQ](https://www.horizonsfoundation.org/chariot/) , or[claim your Chariot account](https://dashboard.givechariot.com/signup) to start receiving grants.
